translation: Ale nie martw się o nas. Damy sobie radę.

source_text: Do you know Duncan Helmer?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Do you know Duncan Helmer?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Do you know Duncan Helmer?"

translation: Znasz Duncana Helmera?

source_text: I’ve never heard the name Duncan Helmer in my life.

structure.raw_value: CaBaEx.I’ve never heard the name Duncan Helmer in my life.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaEx.I’ve never heard the name Duncan Helmer in my life."

translation: Nigdy w życiu nie słyszałam nazwiska Duncan Helmer.

source_text: He knew you.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.He knew you.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.He knew you."

translation: On cię znał.

source_text: Like Hannah said… He must’ve been spying on us.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.Like Hannah said… He must’ve been spying on us.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.Like Hannah said… He must’ve been spying on us."

translation: Jak mówiła Hannah… Musiał nas szpiegować.

source_text: Say, 1Hero. Can you help me with the chicken?

structure.raw_value: CaHaEx.Say, 1Hero. Can you help me with the chicken?
structure.script_literal: "CaHaEx.Say, 1Hero. Can you help me with the chicken?"

translation: Słuchaj, 1Hero. Pomożesz mi z kurczakiem?

source_text: My spice drawer has gone empty. I need to get something for our supper or it’s going to be mighty bland.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.My spice drawer has gone empty. I need to get something for our supper or it’s going to be mighty bland.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.My spice drawer has gone empty. I need to get something for our supper or it’s going to be mighty bland."

translation: Skończyły mi się przyprawy. Muszę coś znaleźć do kolacji, bo będzie strasznie mdła.

source_text: Are you keeping secrets from me, Carol? You know I do interrogate people for a living.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.Are you keeping secrets from me, Carol? You know I do interrogate people for a living.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.Are you keeping secrets from me, Carol? You know I do interrogate people for a living."

translation: Ukrywasz przede mną jakieś sekrety, Carol? Wiesz, że zawodowo przesłuchuję ludzi.

source_text: Am I under arrest, detective?

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.Am I under arrest, detective?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.Am I under arrest, detective?"

translation: Czy jestem aresztowana, detektywie?

source_text: Did you recognize him? Maybe someone from your past?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Did you recognize him? Maybe someone from your past?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Did you recognize him? Maybe someone from your past?"

translation: Rozpoznałaś go? Może to ktoś z twojej przeszłości?

source_text: Sorry, 1Hero. I can’t help you with your case. But if he comes knocking, Hannah and I will be sure to hammer him upside the head real good for ya.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.Sorry, 1Hero. I can’t help you with your case. But if he comes knocking, Hannah and I will be sure to hammer him upside the head real good for ya.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.Sorry, 1Hero. I can’t help you with your case. But if he comes knocking, Hannah and I will be sure to hammer him upside the head real good for ya."

translation: Przykro mi, 1Hero. Nie pomogę ci w śledztwie. Ale jeśli się tu zjawi, Hannah i ja porządnie zdzielimy go czymś po głowie.

source_text: Now, are you going to help me with supper or not?

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.Now, are you going to help me with supper or not?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.Now, are you going to help me with supper or not?"

translation: To jak, pomożesz mi z kolacją czy nie?

source_text: You need spices?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.You need spices?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.You need spices?"

translation: Potrzebujesz przypraw?

source_text: Here, take these keys.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.Here, take these keys.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.Here, take these keys."

translation: Proszę, weź te klucze.

source_text: I’ve got storage bins all around the place. I can’t remember what’s what.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.I’ve got storage bins all around the place. I can’t remember what’s what.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.I’ve got storage bins all around the place. I can’t remember what’s what."

translation: Mam tu wszędzie pojemniki. Nie pamiętam już, co jest w którym.

source_text: I’ll see what I can find. Looking for something specific?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I’ll see what I can find. Looking for something specific?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I’ll see what I can find. Looking for something specific?"

translation: Zobaczę, co znajdę. Szukasz czegoś konkretnego?

source_text: Anything that would be good on chicken.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.Anything that would be good on chicken.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.Anything that would be good on chicken."

translation: Czegokolwiek, co pasowałoby do kurczaka.

source_text: Did you find any good spices for the chicken?

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.Did you find any good spices for the chicken?
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.Did you find any good spices for the chicken?"

translation: Znalazłeś jakieś dobre przyprawy do kurczaka?

source_text: How about some black pepper?

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.How about some black pepper?
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.How about some black pepper?"

translation: Może czarny pieprz?

source_text: Perfect! That’ll do nicely.

structure.raw_value: CaHaOp.Perfect! That’ll do nicely.
structure.script_literal: "CaHaOp.Perfect! That’ll do nicely."

translation: Idealnie! W sam raz.

source_text: I just need a little more time.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.I just need a little more time.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.I just need a little more time."

translation: Potrzebuję jeszcze chwili.

source_text: Cheese on chicken?... I’ve never heard of that.

structure.raw_value: CaBaDe.Cheese on chicken?... I’ve never heard of that.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaDe.Cheese on chicken?... I’ve never heard of that."

translation: Ser do kurczaka?... Nigdy o tym nie słyszałam.

source_text: I have some mecoprop.

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.I have some mecoprop.
structure.script_literal: "McHaEx.I have some mecoprop."

translation: Mam trochę mekopropu.

source_text: That’s weed poison! Are you trying to kill us?

structure.raw_value: CaShClNo1.That’s weed poison! Are you trying to kill us?
structure.script_literal: "CaShClNo1.That’s weed poison! Are you trying to kill us?"

translation: To środek na chwasty! Chcesz nas otruć?

source_text: I just need a little more time and then supper will be ready.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.I just need a little more time and then supper will be ready.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.I just need a little more time and then supper will be ready."

translation: Daj mi jeszcze chwilę, a kolacja będzie gotowa.

source_text: 1Hero!?

structure.raw_value: JuShClNo1.1Hero!?
structure.script_literal: "JuShClNo1.1Hero!?"

translation: 1Hero!?

source_text: Judy!?

structure.raw_value: McWoClNo1.Judy!?
structure.script_literal: "McWoClNo1.Judy!?"

translation: Judy!?

source_text: I heard a noise.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.I heard a noise.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.I heard a noise."

translation: Usłyszałam hałas.

source_text: We’re just wrestling, Sister.

structure.raw_value: CaHaEx>.We’re just wrestling, Sister.
structure.script_literal: "CaHaEx>.We’re just wrestling, Sister."

translation: Po prostu się siłujemy, siostro.

source_text: Oh, my. I’m so sorry to interrupt.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Oh, my. I’m so sorry to interrupt.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Oh, my. I’m so sorry to interrupt."

translation: Ojej. Przepraszam, że wam przeszkodziłam.

source_text: Judy, wait!...

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Judy, wait!...
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Judy, wait!..."

translation: Judy, zaczekaj!...

source_text: I was thinking about tomorrow…

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I was thinking about tomorrow…
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I was thinking about tomorrow…"

translation: Myślałem o jutrze…

source_text: I want to go to church with you.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I want to go to church with you.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I want to go to church with you."

translation: Chcę pójść z tobą do kościoła.

source_text: That’s wonderful.

structure.raw_value: JuHaCl.That’s wonderful.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaCl.That’s wonderful."

translation: Wspaniale.

source_text: You want a snack while you’re up?

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx>.You want a snack while you’re up?
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx>.You want a snack while you’re up?"

translation: Chcesz coś przekąsić, skoro już nie śpisz?

source_text: Oh, no. I should go back to bed.

structure.raw_value: JuFrCl.Oh, no. I should go back to bed.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrCl.Oh, no. I should go back to bed."

translation: Nie, powinnam wrócić do łóżka.

source_text: I hope Hannah’s not keeping you up with snoring.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp>.I hope Hannah’s not keeping you up with snoring.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp>.I hope Hannah’s not keeping you up with snoring."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że Hannah nie chrapie i nie daje ci spać.

source_text: It’s quite comfortable. She’s very warm.

structure.raw_value: JuFrCl.It’s quite comfortable. She’s very warm.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrCl.It’s quite comfortable. She’s very warm."

translation: Jest całkiem wygodnie. Hannah jest bardzo ciepła.

source_text: I’ve never heard that before, but if it floats your boat.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx>.I’ve never heard that before, but if it floats your boat.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx>.I’ve never heard that before, but if it floats your boat."

translation: Pierwszy raz to słyszę, ale skoro ci pasuje.

source_text: Umm… Thank you, Miss Carol.

structure.raw_value: JuHaCl.Umm… Thank you, Miss Carol.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaCl.Umm… Thank you, Miss Carol."

translation: Eee… Dziękuję, pani Carol.

source_text: Yeah, that girl wants it.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.Yeah, that girl wants it.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.Yeah, that girl wants it."

translation: Tak, ta dziewczyna ma na to ochotę.

source_text: Come on, Carol. We were too loud.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Come on, Carol. We were too loud.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Come on, Carol. We were too loud."

translation: Chodź, Carol. Byliśmy za głośno.

source_text: You’re keeping a lot of secrets from me. You know you can come to mama for advice.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.You’re keeping a lot of secrets from me. You know you can come to mama for advice.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.You’re keeping a lot of secrets from me. You know you can come to mama for advice."

translation: Ukrywasz przede mną wiele sekretów. Wiesz, że zawsze możesz przyjść do mamusi po radę.

source_text: Haha. Thanks, Carol.

structure.raw_value: McFlOpNo4.Haha. Thanks, Carol.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOpNo4.Haha. Thanks, Carol."

translation: Haha. Dzięki, Carol.

source_text: And I thought our daughters were too young for you.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.And I thought our daughters were too young for you.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.And I thought our daughters were too young for you."

translation: A myślałam, że nasze córki są dla ciebie za młode.

source_text: Well… I mean… I don’t know what to say.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Well… I mean… I don’t know what to say.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Well… I mean… I don’t know what to say."

translation: Cóż… To znaczy… Nie wiem, co powiedzieć.

source_text: I don’t expect you to kiss and tell, but be careful. They’ll fall in love with you.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.I don’t expect you to kiss and tell, but be careful. They’ll fall in love with you.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.I don’t expect you to kiss and tell, but be careful. They’ll fall in love with you."

translation: Nie oczekuję, że będziesz opowiadać o swoich podbojach, ale uważaj. Zakochają się w tobie.

source_text: Goodnight, 1Hero. And good luck with the nun.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.Goodnight, 1Hero. And good luck with the nun.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.Goodnight, 1Hero. And good luck with the nun."

translation: Dobranoc, 1Hero. Powodzenia z zakonnicą.

source_text: That settles it. I guess I’m going to the church tomorrow.

structure.raw_value: McSaDe^.That settles it. I guess I’m going to the church tomorrow.
structure.script_literal: "McSaDe^.That settles it. I guess I’m going to the church tomorrow."

translation: Postanowione. Chyba jutro pójdę do kościoła.

source_text: I need to keep guard anyway. I just need to be sure I don’t fall asleep…

structure.raw_value: McBaDe^.I need to keep guard anyway. I just need to be sure I don’t fall asleep…
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe^.I need to keep guard anyway. I just need to be sure I don’t fall asleep…"

translation: I tak muszę pilnować tego miejsca. Byle tylko nie zasnąć…

source_text: Church is so boring.

structure.raw_value: McSaDe^.Church is so boring.
structure.script_literal: "McSaDe^.Church is so boring."

translation: W kościele jest tak nudno.

source_text: Damn. I need to sleep.

structure.raw_value: McWoDe^.Damn. I need to sleep.
structure.script_literal: "McWoDe^.Damn. I need to sleep."

translation: Cholera. Muszę się przespać.

source_text: Am I the first one awake?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Am I the first one awake?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Am I the first one awake?"

translation: Jestem pierwszy na nogach?

source_text: I hope sister Judy’s not late.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I hope sister Judy’s not late.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I hope sister Judy’s not late."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że siostra Judy się nie spóźni.

source_text: 1Hero.. This isn’t your home.

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.1Hero.. This isn’t your home.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.1Hero.. This isn’t your home."

translation: 1Hero… To nie twój dom.

source_text: The weather was bad last night, so I stayed at Carol’s house with the girls.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.The weather was bad last night, so I stayed at Carol’s house with the girls.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.The weather was bad last night, so I stayed at Carol’s house with the girls."

translation: W nocy była kiepska pogoda, więc zostałem z dziewczynami u Carol.

source_text: The girls?

structure.raw_value: ArBaOp.The girls?
structure.script_literal: "ArBaOp.The girls?"

translation: Z dziewczynami?

source_text: Sister Judy is here too. I’m going to church with her.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Sister Judy is here too. I’m going to church with her.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Sister Judy is here too. I’m going to church with her."

translation: Siostra Judy też tu jest. Idę z nią do kościoła.

source_text: Hooray! Congratulations for being saved from hell, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ArHaAg.Hooray! Congratulations for being saved from hell, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ArHaAg.Hooray! Congratulations for being saved from hell, 1Hero."

translation: Hura! Gratuluję, że uniknąłeś piekła, 1Hero.

source_text: I have to guard the place. I’m not going to do any weird worshiping stuff.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I have to guard the place. I’m not going to do any weird worshiping stuff.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I have to guard the place. I’m not going to do any weird worshiping stuff."

translation: Muszę pilnować tego miejsca. Nie będę brał udziału w żadnych dziwnych obrzędach.

source_text: There is no such thing as weird worshiping. Worship is such a wonderful thing!

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.There is no such thing as weird worshiping. Worship is such a wonderful thing!
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.There is no such thing as weird worshiping. Worship is such a wonderful thing!"

translation: Nie ma czegoś takiego jak dziwne obrzędy. Oddawanie czci jest wspaniałe!

source_text: I'm sure it is for some people.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.I'm sure it is for some people.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.I'm sure it is for some people."

translation: Dla niektórych na pewno.

source_text: Hey, Arianna. What is sex?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Hey, Arianna. What is sex?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Hey, Arianna. What is sex?"

translation: Hej, Arianno. Czym jest seks?

source_text: Are you seriously asking me that? You engage in it all the time!

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.Are you seriously asking me that? You engage in it all the time!
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.Are you seriously asking me that? You engage in it all the time!"

translation: Naprawdę mnie o to pytasz? Przecież cały czas uprawiasz seks!

source_text: But, how do you define it?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.But, how do you define it?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.But, how do you define it?"

translation: Ale jak byś go zdefiniowała?

source_text: It’s an act meant for making babies. Yet you use it like a game. It’s very sinful!

structure.raw_value: ArWoEx.It’s an act meant for making babies. Yet you use it like a game. It’s very sinful!
structure.script_literal: "ArWoEx.It’s an act meant for making babies. Yet you use it like a game. It’s very sinful!"

translation: To akt, który ma służyć płodzeniu dzieci. A wy traktujecie go jak zabawę. To bardzo grzeszne!

source_text: But what if we don’t make babies?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.But what if we don’t make babies?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.But what if we don’t make babies?"

translation: A jeśli nie chcemy mieć dzieci?

source_text: The act is meant only for making new people. You should not engage in acts meant for procreation unless that’s your intention.

structure.raw_value: ArWoEx.The act is meant only for making new people. You should not engage in acts meant for procreation unless that’s your intention.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoEx.The act is meant only for making new people. You should not engage in acts meant for procreation unless that’s your intention."

translation: Seks służy wyłącznie poczęciu nowego życia. Nie powinieneś go uprawiać, jeśli nie zamierzasz mieć dzieci.

source_text: Hmm… Interesting.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.Hmm… Interesting.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.Hmm… Interesting."

translation: Hmm… Ciekawe.

source_text: No reason… It’s just… People have a lot of holes.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.No reason… It’s just… People have a lot of holes.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.No reason… It’s just… People have a lot of holes."

translation: Bez powodu… Po prostu… Ludzie mają mnóstwo dziurek.

source_text: Holes?

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.Holes?
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.Holes?"

translation: Dziurek?

source_text: I mean… I can see at least one on you.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I mean… I can see at least one on you.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I mean… I can see at least one on you."

translation: To znaczy… Widzę, że ty też masz przynajmniej jedną.

source_text: I have a hole you can see!? Oh, dear!

structure.raw_value: ArWoAgNo1.I have a hole you can see!? Oh, dear!
structure.script_literal: "ArWoAgNo1.I have a hole you can see!? Oh, dear!"

translation: Mam widoczną dziurę!? Ojej!

source_text: Your mouth.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Your mouth.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Your mouth."

translation: Chodzi o twoje usta.

source_text: I suppose a mouth is a hole… That’s a strange way of seeing the world.

structure.raw_value: ArWoOp.I suppose a mouth is a hole… That’s a strange way of seeing the world.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoOp.I suppose a mouth is a hole… That’s a strange way of seeing the world."

translation: W sumie usta to też otwór… Dziwnie patrzysz na świat.

source_text: Guys tend to like holes. What can I say?

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Guys tend to like holes. What can I say?
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Guys tend to like holes. What can I say?"

translation: Faceci lubią dziurki. Co ja poradzę?

source_text: You Earthlings have interesting hobbies.

structure.raw_value: ArFrDe.You Earthlings have interesting hobbies.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrDe.You Earthlings have interesting hobbies."

translation: Wy, Ziemianie, macie ciekawe hobby.

source_text: Hannah will be excited to have a new goat pet. She sure does miss having cats.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.Hannah will be excited to have a new goat pet. She sure does miss having cats.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.Hannah will be excited to have a new goat pet. She sure does miss having cats."

translation: Hannah ucieszy się z nowej koziej przyjaciółki. Na pewno tęskni za kotami.

source_text: Let’s just hope the goat fares better than the cats.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Let’s just hope the goat fares better than the cats.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Let’s just hope the goat fares better than the cats."

translation: Miejmy nadzieję, że koza będzie miała więcej szczęścia niż koty.

source_text: You liked it, Hannah. Don’t lie.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.You liked it, Hannah. Don’t lie.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.You liked it, Hannah. Don’t lie."

translation: Smakowało ci, Hannah. Nie kłam.

source_text: Aww, Ma! I don’t want to talk about 1Hero’s willy with you!

structure.raw_value: HnSaOp^.Aww, Ma! I don’t want to talk about 1Hero’s willy with you!
structure.script_literal: "HnSaOp^.Aww, Ma! I don’t want to talk about 1Hero’s willy with you!"

translation: Aww, mamo! Nie chcę z tobą rozmawiać o siusiaku 1Hero!

source_text: Looks like your debt is paid, Hannah.

structure.raw_value: ElFlEx.Looks like your debt is paid, Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlEx.Looks like your debt is paid, Hannah."

translation: Wygląda na to, że spłaciłaś dług, Hannah.

source_text: You ladies sure are making quick friends with one another.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.You ladies sure are making quick friends with one another.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.You ladies sure are making quick friends with one another."

translation: Szybko się zaprzyjaźniłyście.

source_text: I like Ella, but I like food more. Feed me!

structure.raw_value: HnAnEx^.I like Ella, but I like food more. Feed me!
structure.script_literal: "HnAnEx^.I like Ella, but I like food more. Feed me!"

translation: Lubię Ellę, ale jedzenie lubię bardziej. Dajcie mi jeść!

source_text: Manners!

structure.raw_value: CaMaAgNo1.Manners!
structure.script_literal: "CaMaAgNo1.Manners!"

translation: A maniery?

source_text: Hmph!

structure.raw_value: HnAnDeNo1^.Hmph!
structure.script_literal: "HnAnDeNo1^.Hmph!"

translation: Phi!

source_text: Need any help with dinner?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Need any help with dinner?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Need any help with dinner?"

translation: Potrzebujesz pomocy przy kolacji?

source_text: I’ve got this. You all keep our guest entertained.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.I’ve got this. You all keep our guest entertained.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.I’ve got this. You all keep our guest entertained."

translation: Poradzę sobie. Wy zabawiajcie naszego gościa.

source_text: Oh, I’m plenty entertained already.

structure.raw_value: ElFlOp.Oh, I’m plenty entertained already.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlOp.Oh, I’m plenty entertained already."

translation: Och, już świetnie się bawię.

source_text: I hope the goat didn’t break anything. Ma will blame me!

structure.raw_value: HnSaOp.I hope the goat didn’t break anything. Ma will blame me!
structure.script_literal: "HnSaOp.I hope the goat didn’t break anything. Ma will blame me!"

translation: Oby koza niczego nie zniszczyła. Mama będzie mnie obwiniać!
